v1.2.0b (19 April 2022) |feed_title = Duck Hunting Season! |previous_update = [[V1.1.0|Entity System Update]] |next_update = [[v1.2.1]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.2.0''' is the thirty-fourth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 17th of April 2022. This update was also given the name '''Duck Hunt Update''', as it added the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.2.0 update (released 17 April 2022) and two minor updates, the v1.2.0a (released 17 April 2022) and v1.2.0b (released 19 April 2022). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Engineer]] ===Enemies=== *[[Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky]] *[[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Cool Ducky]] *[[Fat Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Fat Ducky]] *[[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Ducky]] *[[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Mother Ducky]] *[[Cart]] *[[Eggroll]] *[[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Flying Ducky]] *[[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]] *[[Explosive Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Explosive Ducky]] *[[Operator Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Operator Ducky]] *[[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Agent Ducky]] *[[Evil Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Evil Ducky]] *[[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Long Ducky]] *[[Ducky Unit (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky Unit]] *[[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky D00M]] ===Maps=== *[[D00M's Revenge]] ([[Duck Hunt Event]]) ===Seasons=== *[[Duck Hunt Event#Hunting Season Pass|Hunting Season]] **Rewards: ***Rank 1 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Sniper]] ***Rank 2 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Soldier]] & [[Golden Soldier]] ***Rank 3 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Hunter]] ***Rank 4 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Militant]] ***Rank 5 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Shotgunner]] ***Rank 6 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Minigunner]] & [[Golden Minigunner]] ***Rank 7 - {{Color|DuckHunt|Ducky}} [[Commander]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Duck Hunt Event]] *Plot buying mechanic *Passive income mechanic *Interactables mechanic *{{Eggs|Eggs}} ==Removals== *[[Season of Love#Season Pass|Season of Love]] **All rewards are now unobtainable *Cash Trails setting ==Changes & Bugfixes== *All towers have new faces, with some exceptions: **{{Color|Unobtainable|Slayer}} [[Shotgunner]] **{{Color|SeasonOfLove|Cupid}} [[Crook Boss]] **{{Color|Premium|XR500}} [[Turret]] **Default [[War Machine]] *[[Shotgunner]]'s all skins appearance changed. *[[Shotgunner]] reworked. **Damage of each bullet is no longer decreased by 50% with each pierce. It now deals full damage to first two enemies and half of the damage to the last enemy. ***Pierce is no longer based on how high the damage of '''Shotgunner''' is, instead all Levels have a pierce of 2. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Placement cost decreased from {{Money|500}} to {{Money|400}}. ****Damage increased from 1x6 to 2x6. ***'''Level 1''' ****Damage decreased from +1 to +0. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|2.525 > 2.275|-0.25}} to {{Tooltip|2.525 > 1.825|-0.7}}. ****Spread of 80 added. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|350}} to {{Money|1,250}}. ****Damage increased from +0 to +1. ****Bullets changed from 6 to 6 > 8. ****Spread change of 80 > 60 added. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,500}} to {{Money|3,500}}. ****Damage decreased from +4 to +2. ****Firerate changed from DuckHuntEvent.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Duck Hunt 2022 icon.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Ducks1.png Ducks2.png Ducks3.png Ducks4.png Penguin.png DuckyD00MPI.png EngineerRevealPI1.jpg EngineerRevealPI2.jpg DuckHuntPI.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log.
